linkedin.title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone the same.
linkedin.body:
We are drowning in information, but we are starving for relevance. Most apps and websites try to solve this by showing you the same trending stories as everyone else. They assume that if a topic is popular, it must be important to you. But that is rarely the case.

True personalization is not about showing you more of what you already click on. It is about understanding the context of your day. It means delivering the stories that actually matter to your life and your work, without the noise of the global outrage cycle.

We built Headlinne to change this dynamic. We use AI to filter out the clutter and focus on the information that respects your time. It is a tool for people who want to stay informed without feeling overwhelmed.

reels.title: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
reels.hook: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport

beats.caption: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
Miami International handles more traffic than most cities see in a month.
beats.detail: A massive hub for global travel.
beats.narration: Miami International is like a small city that never stops moving.

beats.caption: An Amazon cargo plane crashed at the airport this Sunday afternoon.
beats.detail: A sudden, tragic event in Florida.
beats.narration: But yesterday afternoon, an Amazon cargo plane crashed right on the runway.

beats.caption: At least five people have died following the impact.
beats.detail: Five lives lost in the wreckage.
beats.narration: At least five people lost their lives in the accident.

beats.caption: Three are in critical condition with two more hospitalized.
beats.narration: Three others are in critical condition, while two more remain hospitalized.

beats.caption: The flight overshot the runway and struck several vehicles.
beats.narration: The plane was arriving from Puerto Rico when it overshot the runway and hit several vehicles.

beats.caption: Operations at the busy airport have been brought to a halt.
beats.narration: This forced operations at one of the busiest US airports to a complete stop.

beats.caption: Get the facts on this and more at headlinne.com.

story_card.headline: A quiet neutron star just started acting up
story_card.standfirst: Astronomers caught a previously stable pulsar suddenly changing its spin rate.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A young pulsar called PSR J1637−4642 suddenly experienced three rapid rotational glitches.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Experts monitored the star for 15 years using the Parkes radio telescope.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This star had shown no glitches before, changing its spin by nearly 3 parts per million.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Scientists will continue observing the star to see if more unexpected spin changes occur.

story_card.caption:
Astronomers have detected three unexpected rotational glitches in the pulsar known as PSR J1637−4642.

This neutron star was previously thought to be quiet and stable. Data from the Parkes radio telescope revealed the sudden shifts after 15 years of quiet observation.

Do you think we will ever fully understand the unpredictable behavior of neutron stars?
